_doc: Advisories `make mobile-audit` (scripts/npm-audit.js) tolerates. Only for findings with NO fixed release. Every entry needs a reason and a review_by date: the gate FAILS once review_by has passed (re-evaluate, then renew with a new reason or delete) and FAILS if npm audit no longer reports the advisory (upstream fixed it — delete the entry). Lower severities are never gated.

allow.reason: metro's build-time asset-dimension parser (ICNS infinite loop). Only runs over images committed to this repo at bundle time; never shipped to devices or the backend. Every published version through 2.0.2 is flagged, so no override can clear it; metro pins ^1.0.2.
Same package and exposure as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr (JXL/HEIF infinite loops).

Build-time-only Expo tooling dep — plist parsing during prebuild/config (expo-updates -> @expo/plist, and expo -> config-plugins -> xcode -> simple-plist -> plist). Never bundled into the app on user devices or the backend. All 0.8.x are vulnerable and the parents pin ^0.8, so the only fix is a major 0.9+/1.x override that risks breaking Expo's config tooling. AGGRESSIVE review_by: re-triage in ~2 weeks (expect an Expo transitive bump to clear it).
Same package and exposure as GHSA-w2rr-34g9-rvrj (build-time-only Expo plist tooling).
